name: 23106-eagleprefix-qwen38b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B as the target with AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3 as the EAGLE3 draft head. Both are ungated and already in the local HF cache; the draft head ships no tokenizer and uses the target's.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 320 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 42: one shared prefix of 36864 tokens (`prefix_buckets`, `prefix_count: 1`) in front of every request, then a unique 1024-token query with zero variance, then a fixed 128-token answer; `temperature: 0` and `ignore_eos: true` in `extras.body`, so the token stream is deterministic and every request generates its full 128 tokens.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter assistant with draft-model acceleration answering long shared-context queries at eight concurrent streams on eight GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line.
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is not read, and the engine would then start
# without something this file declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 8

# EAGLE3 as a CHAIN, not a tree: topk 1 x 3 steps -> 4 verified positions.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# 40960 is what both the target and the draft head declare, and the engine gives the draft the
# TARGET's context length -- a larger value needs an environment variable to permit it, which
# no file here can set. Written out because the workload is sized against it.
context-length: 40960

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
random-seed: 42
